root_cause: Pre-existing duplication, not a defect: feedback.tsx and contacts.tsx ContactDetailView each built the self + peer MemberProfile map, with the self entry the same in both. ContactChat repeated the source === 'feedback' check at four send-path gates.
fix: Added buildDmProfileMap({ selfHex, selfProfile, peerHex, peerNickname, peerAvatar, peerUpdatedAt? }) to app/src/lib/contacts.ts and called it from both pages. The self fallback, avatar and build-time updatedAt are unchanged, the peer updatedAt defaults to build time, and entries are inserted in the same order. ContactChat sets const isFeedback once; the four gates stay separate explicit checks.
deviations_from_design: The finding named three feedback gates; there are now four (allowMessageActions). All are kept separate.
Feedback page: self and peer updatedAt now share one build-time timestamp instead of two new Date() calls.
mutation: not run: pure refactor, new helper fully pinned by unit tests
